body: Forward test of the flags-judgment context method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.72 (naive base rate 0.80) that: AAON FY2026 net sales growth is ≥72% (low end of its raised 72–75% outlook). Evidence: 8-K 9-Nov-2026: Q3 net sales +84.1% to record $707.4M; BASX (data-centre) +218%; AAON-branded +19.6%; backlog +40.5% YoY to $1.9B but −5.9% QoQ. Outlook raised to 72–75% growth (prior 55–60%), GM ~26%. Same release: restated Q1 and Q2 2026 (H1 net sales +$10.7M, GM +71 bps, EPS +$0.09) and disclosed a material weakness in ICFR; 'no evidence of fraud'. Reasoning: Flags-judgment: a restatement plus material weakness is a classic warning, but here the restatement raised prior numbers and the guide needs only Q4. The QoQ backlog decline and revenue-recognition-control questions keep us below the 'only one quarter left' base. Resolution: YES if AAON's FY2026 reported net sales ÷ FY2025 net sales − 1 ≥ 72.0% (per the Q4/FY2026 earnings release or 10-K; use the company's stated growth figure if given). Source: AAON Q4 2026 earnings 8-K / FY2026 10-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 824142). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs base rate.
